# Cncf Orkestrix Mk8s Qks Reviewer

Review ORKESTRIX mK8s (QKS) using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. ORKESTRIX mK8s(QKS) is a multi-tenant, multi-cluster Kubernetes distribution by QUANTUM C&amp;S that enables organizations to provision and operate multiple isolated Kubernetes clusters at scale on customer on-premises infrastructure via the ORKESTRIX platform, with full automation of cluster lifecycle including provisioning, scaling, upgrades, and day-2 operations.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
